name: @alberttanure/catpilot-cli
description: 😺 CatPilot: a playful personal secretary for GitHub Copilot CLI (tasks, journal, milestones, memos, summaries)
author: Albert Tanure

scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build:core && npm run dev --workspace @catpilot/desktop
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace @catpilot/desktop
scripts.desktop:check: npm run build:core && npm run check --workspace @catpilot/desktop
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run desktop:build && npm run pack --workspace @catpilot/desktop
scripts.test:pwa: npm run pwa:build && node --test apps/pwa/src/storage.test.mjs apps/pwa/src/storage-download.test.mjs && node test/pwa-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:desktop: npm run build:core && node --test test/workspaces.test.mjs test/migration.test.mjs test/management.test.mjs test/workspace-surfaces.test.mjs test/workspace-bridge.test.mjs apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/pagination.test.mjs apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/workspace-views.test.mjs apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/assets.test.mjs apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/proposal.test.mjs apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/autosave.test.mjs apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/blocks.test.mjs
scripts.test:provider: tsc --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --strict --skipLibCheck --rootDir . --outDir dist/provider-test apps/desktop/src/main/provider.ts && node --experimental-test-module-mocks --test test/provider.test.mjs
scripts.test: node test/quick-test.js && node test/adapter-integration.js && node test/canvas-bridge.js && node test/canvas-port.js && node test/mcp-smoke.js && node test/period-tasks.mjs && node test/canvas-inline-tasks.js
